title: EU AI Act Article 15 — Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
description: The accuracy/robustness/cybersecurity requirement for high-risk AI systems within the EU AI Act. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary EUR-Lex text — hence 'Community' confidence.
control_text: High-risk AI systems must achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity throughout their lifecycle, including resilience against errors, faults, and attempts to manipulate the system.

citations.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
citations.publisher: EUR-Lex / Official Journal of the European Union

relationships.reason: Satisfying this control requires a documented safety case demonstrating robustness safeguards were tested.
